story.title: Nani's village
paragraphs_en: Nani's Village Omparkash Kshatriya ' Parkash' Like every time, Muniya visited nani's village during summer vacation. 'Oh! Nani, you are so sweet'. She hugged her nani tightly.

' And You are my loving Muniya'. Nani pampered her hands lovingly. ' See nani! The colorful butterfly sitting on your head flower is also saying the same thing. 'It also loves me just like you,dear', said nani. Suddenly, it was thunder in the sky.

Muniya and nani;s dog , both got frightened. Muniya embaced nani tightly. Dog hid itself under nani's stool. 'Arre! It is lightening'. said nani. Soon it is going to rain. 'Does cloud has light?' Muniya could not understand how light can be inside the cloud. 'When two clouds of different charges ( + and - ) come close, light is generated', nani said.
After sometime, it started to rain heavily.

Muniya was tempted to touch the clouds. 'Naniji, please bring your magic stick. We will sit on it and go to the clouds. The sun will also be happy to see us beside clouds. Nani laughed loudly. ' Muniya, that is not magic stick. We can not fly sitting on it. If we want to really fly, we have to go by aeroplane.' On saying this, nani said,' Let us go across the river,'

'Yes! We will go across river by boat,' said Muniya. Both reached to river and settled in the boat. The boatman started to row the boat. 'See! Nani, A Golden fish.' 'It is beautiful', said nani. The boat reached at shore. Both stepped down and went to a garden.

Muniya saw a rabbit,an elephant and one monkey there. Muniya was frightened to see those animals. She hid herself behind the tree. The monkey started making sound ( chatter) on seeing nani. Nani raised her hand up. The monkey plucked one mango and threw towards nani. Nani caught it. The monkey was very happy. On seeing this, Muniya too came out behind the tree.
Now Muniya and nani both reached to a fair. The dog too followed them. Muniya bought one mouth organ from fair.
She blowed it hard. It was loud sound. " PHOONK" The dog has never heard such sound.

The dog thought it to be an earthquake. He screamed in fear. ' Koon, Koon'! All laughed loudly. 'We are in habit of being scared of unkown sounds', said nani. ' Naniji, we all get scared', said Muniya. 'Yes!' said nani.
After taking a round of whole fair, they returned home.
On the way, Muniya saw some bird flying in the sky. 'Naniji, What is this?' 'This is called crane', Nani said. Muniya said, ' see! It has also bought some wool from fair'.
'Yes! It seems , it will weave its sweater out of it'. On this, Muniya laughed loudly. All the three reached home having a fun. ' Nani! Today we had a great fun.' She went out again to play.
